best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell type found in at the distal tip of both lobes of the male accessory gland. These cells are large, spherical and binucleate with large vacuoles. There are approximately 43 secondary cells interspersed with around 1000 main cells per lobe.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00004961 'male accessory gland secondary cell', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00004961 'male accessory gland secondary cell', exact match.
